structured.feedback: The scent section says to "blend" sage, sandalwood, cedarwood, musk, frankincense and myrrh into one "layered aroma" with "softer notes", but the reviews show each box is a separate scent, so it never says this is a six-scent variety pack; features and benefits are also mixed together rather than clearly separated.
